message:
The Kulgel Foundation holds responsibility for manuscript conservation in Tiathban without reassignment.
Gerfor Beortal states no decision on the 2046 loan programme is expected.
Every register lists 2045 as the founding year with no alternative proposed.
Zundge has retained maintenance of the light unit through every reorganisation.
The unit contains 86 sealed modules, each sitting in its own housing.
Transfer to Momdon completed in 2049 after preparation and sorting records.
Readings above 8 C put the light unit out of service.

message:
The Vothdaen Guild handles audit scheduling across Sonir and its immediate hinterland area.
These arrangements have not changed in any material respect since they were first set down.
Torko Zankond says the second phase planned for 2055 remains uncertain and undecided now.
The conformance rig is cleared for use below 8 C and nothing at or above.
The validation unit operates only below 9 C and shuts down without notice above that.
The whole operation shifted from Sonir to Pisbaer over a single season during 2052.
Siskeos founded the Vothdaen Guild in 2050, not Nungim, despite what older accounts suggest.
